<style>
/* =========================================================
   NẠP THẺ TRANG CHỦ
========================================================= */

#napthe .home-charge-heading,
#napthe #form-charge2 {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
                 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}


/* ================================
   PHẦN CHUNG
================================ */

.home-charge-section {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.home-charge-details {
    display: none;
}


/* ================================
   TIÊU ĐỀ BƯỚC 1 - 2 - 3
================================ */

.home-charge-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;

    color: #202020;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 650;
}

.home-charge-step {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
}


/* ================================
   NHÀ MẠNG
================================ */

.home-charge-provider-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.home-charge-provider,
.home-charge-more {
    min-height: 42px;
    padding: 7px 5px;

    border: 1px solid #dedede;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #252525;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 650;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        border-color .15s ease,
        background-color .15s ease,
        color .15s ease,
        box-shadow .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-provider:hover,
.home-charge-more:hover {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    color: #e53935;
}

.home-charge-provider.is-selected {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    background: #fff5f5;

    color: #e53935;

    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 77, 79, .08);
}


/* ================================
   THẺ ÍT DÙNG
================================ */

.home-charge-extra {
    display: none;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 8px;
}

.home-charge-extra.is-open {
    display: grid;
}


/* ================================
   MỆNH GIÁ
================================ */

.home-charge-amount-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 8px;
}

.home-charge-amount {
    min-height: 42px;

    border: 1px solid #dedede;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #222;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        border-color .15s ease,
        background-color .15s ease,
        color .15s ease,
        box-shadow .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-amount:hover {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    color: #e53935;
}

.home-charge-amount.is-selected {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    background: #ff4d4f;

    color: #fff;

    box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(255, 77, 79, .18);
}


/* ================================
   CẢNH BÁO SAU KHI CHỌN MỆNH GIÁ
================================ */

.home-charge-summary {
    display: none;

    margin-bottom: 14px;
    padding: 10px 12px;

    border: 1px solid #f2cf91;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff9ed;
    color: #77510c;

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.home-charge-summary strong {
    color: #e53935;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.home-charge-summary small {
    display: block;

    margin-top: 4px;

    color: #755b2f;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}


/* ================================
   INPUT
================================ */

.home-charge-input {
    min-height: 42px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    font-family: inherit;
}

.home-charge-input:focus {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 .15rem rgba(255, 77, 79, .10);
}


/* ================================
   NÚT NẠP
================================ */

.home-charge-submit {
    min-height: 46px;

    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;

    transition:
        background-color .15s ease,
        opacity .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-submit:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: #e93d40;
    color: #fff;
}

.home-charge-submit:disabled {
    background: #e6e6e6;
    color: #999;

    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 1;
}


/* =========================================================
   HEADER "NẠP THẺ NHANH"
========================================================= */

.home-charge-heading {
    padding: 1px 0 5px;
}

.home-charge-heading-icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    margin-right: 9px;

    border-radius: 9px;

    background: #fff1f1;
    color: #f04444;

    font-size: 23px;
}

.home-charge-heading-title {
    color: #161616;

    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: -.15px;
}

.home-charge-heading-sub {
    margin-top: 2px;

    color: #777;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
}


/* =========================================================
   BOX "NẠP THẺ TỰ ĐỘNG 24/7"
========================================================= */

.home-charge-intro {
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 12px 13px;

    border: 1px solid #f0d3ad;
    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #fffaf3;
}

.home-charge-intro-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.home-charge-intro-icon {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    margin-right: 10px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-size: 22px;
}

.home-charge-intro-title {
    color: #df3438;

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.25;
    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: 0;
}

.home-charge-intro-text {
    margin-top: 3px;

    color: #666;

    font-size: 11.5px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
}


/* 3 ƯU ĐIỂM */

.home-charge-benefits {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 11px;
}

.home-charge-benefits span {
    padding: 7px 3px;

    border: 1px solid #f3eee8;
    border-radius: 7px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #444;

    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.25;
    font-weight: 600;

    text-align: center;
}


/* CẢNH BÁO DƯỚI BOX */

.home-charge-intro-warning {
    margin-top: 9px;
    padding-top: 8px;

    border-top: 1px dashed #e8c181;

    color: #825708;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 500;
}


/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 767px) {

    /* Nhà mạng: 2 nút / hàng */
    .home-charge-provider-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .home-charge-provider,
    .home-charge-more {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 13px;
    }


    /* Mệnh giá: 3 nút / hàng */
    .home-charge-amount {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 15px;
    }


    /* Input */
    .home-charge-input {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 16px;
    }


    /* Nút nạp */
    .home-charge-submit {
        min-height: 50px;
        font-size: 15px;
    }


    /* Tiêu đề */
    .home-charge-heading-title {
        font-size: 17px;
    }

    .home-charge-heading-sub {
        font-size: 11px;
    }


    /* Box giới thiệu */
    .home-charge-intro {
        margin-top: 11px;
        padding: 11px 12px;
    }

    .home-charge-intro-title {
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    .home-charge-intro-text {
        font-size: 11.5px;
    }


    /* Vẫn giữ 3 ô trên mobile để box không quá dài */
    .home-charge-benefits {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 5px;
    }

    .home-charge-benefits span {
        padding: 6px 3px;
        font-size: 9.5px;
    }


    .home-charge-summary {
        font-size: 13px;
    }
}
/* =========================================================
   POPUP XÁC NHẬN NẠP THẺ
========================================================= */

.charge-confirm-modal {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
                 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}

.charge-confirm-modal .modal-header {
    padding-top: 22px;
}

.charge-confirm-icon {
    width: 52px;
    height: 52px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 auto 10px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fff1f1;
    color: #ff4d4f;
    font-size: 28px;
}

.charge-confirm-modal .modal-title {
    color: #181818;
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.charge-confirm-sub {
    margin-top: 4px;
    color: #888;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.charge-confirm-info {
    margin-top: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #eee;
    border-radius: 11px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #fafafa;
}

.charge-confirm-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.charge-confirm-row + .charge-confirm-row {
    border-top: 1px solid #eee;
}

.charge-confirm-row span {
    color: #666;
}

.charge-confirm-row strong {
    color: #e53935;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.charge-confirm-warning {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 1px solid #f1d39d;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #fff9ec;
    color: #79520d;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.45;
}

.charge-confirm-warning-icon {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: #e29a15;
    font-size: 21px;
}

.charge-confirm-warning strong {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    color: #654300;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.charge-confirm-back,
.charge-confirm-submit {
    min-height: 46px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.charge-confirm-back {
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    background: #fff;
    color: #555;
}

.charge-confirm-back:hover {
    background: #f5f5f5;
    color: #333;
}

.charge-confirm-submit {
    border: 0;
    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;
}

.charge-confirm-submit:hover {
    background: #e93d40;
    color: #fff;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {

    #chargeConfirmModal .modal-dialog {
        margin: 15px;
    }

    .charge-confirm-modal .modal-title {
        font-size: 19px;
    }

    .charge-confirm-row {
        padding: 12px;
    }

    .charge-confirm-back,
    .charge-confirm-submit {
        min-height: 48px;
    }
}

/* Giao diện theo ảnh mẫu. Chỉ áp dụng trong cột nạp thẻ. */
#napthe .home-charge-panel{box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 11px 12px!important;border:1px solid #ffc5c8;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#fffdfc,#fff8f8);box-shadow:0 4px 15px #ed34341a;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#17202c}
#napthe .home-charge-heading{position:relative;padding:3px 0 5px;min-height:52px;margin-bottom:10px!important;padding-right:103px}
#napthe .home-charge-heading-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.1px;color:#10151d}
#napthe .home-charge-heading-title em{font-style:normal;color:#ff252e}
#napthe .home-charge-heading-sub{font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;color:#707982;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:-.15px}
#napthe .home-charge-heading-icon{width:38px;height:40px;margin-right:8px;background:#fff0f1;border-radius:50%}
.home-charge-panel .hc-sprite,.home-charge-panel .hc-mascot{display:inline-block;flex-shrink:0;background-image:url('https://hungakiraroblox.pro/assets/home-charge/reference.png');background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:478px 520px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-bolt{width:24px;height:31px;background-position:-39px -24px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-mascot{position:absolute;right:0;top:-6px;width:109px;height:57px;background-position:-327px -14px}
#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab{display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;border:1px solid #e6e6eb;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;background:#f8f9fb;padding:0;margin:0 0 11px!important;gap:0}
#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab .nav-item{flex:1;min-width:0;margin:0}
#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab .nav-link{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;width:100%;height:33px;padding:0 4px;border:0;border-right:1px solid #e9e9ee;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#192330;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab .nav-link.active{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ff4248,#ef282f);color:white;border-radius:6px}
#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab .nav-link:before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:20px;height:19px;background-image:url('https://hungakiraroblox.pro/assets/home-charge/reference.png');background-size:478px 520px;background-position:-52px -82px}
#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab #pills-chuyen-khoan-tab:before{background-position:-171px -81px}
#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab #pills-top-tab:before{background-position:-319px -80px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-banner{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;min-height:72px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:12px;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#ff474b,#f02129);border-radius:11px;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 10px #ef30302b}
.home-charge-panel .hc-banner-card{width:49px;height:50px;background-position:-44px -130px;border-radius:11px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-banner-title{font-size:27px;line-height:30px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.7px;white-space:nowrap}
.home-charge-panel .hc-banner-title b{color:#ffe322;font-size:35px;margin-right:5px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-banner p{font-size:9px;margin:4px 0 0;white-space:nowrap}
.home-charge-panel .hc-arrow{position:absolute;right:13px;top:12px;background:#ffffff29;border-radius:50%;width:33px;height:33px;text-align:center;font-size:28px;line-height:30px}
#napthe .home-charge-label{gap:12px;margin-bottom:9px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
#napthe .home-charge-label small{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:#606a78;margin-top:3px}
#napthe .home-charge-step{width:35px;height:35px;font-size:17px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#ff454c,#e91f2b)}
#napthe .home-charge-provider-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px 6px}
#napthe .home-charge-provider,#napthe .home-charge-more{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:10px;min-height:40px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #e0e3e8;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(#fff,#fcfdff);color:#1c2632}
#napthe .home-charge-provider:hover,#napthe .home-charge-provider.is-selected{border-color:#ff4a59;background:#fff5f5;color:#f52235;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ff4d4f08}
.home-charge-panel .hc-logo{width:44px;height:27px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-viettel{background-position:-41px -252px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-mobifone{background-position:-175px -252px}

.home-charge-panel .hc-zing{background-position:-42px -297px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-garena{background-position:-176px -297px}

#napthe .home-charge-section{margin-bottom:11px}
#napthe .home-charge-intro{margin-top:11px;padding:10px 12px 8px;border-color:#ffd79f;border-radius:10px;background:#fffaf2}
#napthe .home-charge-intro-icon{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff703a,#ff402e);border-radius:10px;width:42px;height:42px;margin-right:11px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-intro-card{width:26px;height:23px;background-position:-53px -363px}

#napthe .home-charge-intro-text{font-size:10px;color:#68717b}
#napthe .home-charge-benefits{gap:10px;margin-top:8px}
#napthe .home-charge-benefits span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:5px 2px;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:7px;height:32px;box-sizing:border-box}
#napthe .home-charge-benefits span:nth-child(1){color:#00a54d;background:#f2fff6;border-color:#e0f0e4}
#napthe .home-charge-benefits span:nth-child(2){color:#0088ee;background:#f4fbff;border-color:#e2ecf4}
#napthe .home-charge-benefits span:nth-child(3){color:#8e2bd6;background:#fcf8ff;border-color:#ede4f3}
.home-charge-panel .hc-gear,.home-charge-panel .hc-shield,.home-charge-panel .hc-headset,.home-charge-panel .hc-warning{width:22px;height:23px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-gear{background-position:-55px -405px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-shield{background-position:-186px -405px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-headset{background-position:-314px -405px}
.home-charge-panel .hc-warning{background-position:-44px -444px}
#napthe .home-charge-intro-warning{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:7px;padding-top:3px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#ec6500;border-color:#ffdda9}
@media(max-width:1199px) and (min-width:992px){#napthe .home-charge-heading{padding-right:0}.home-charge-panel .hc-mascot{display:none}.home-charge-panel .hc-banner-title{font-size:21px}.home-charge-panel .hc-arrow{display:none}.home-charge-panel .hc-banner p{white-space:normal}#napthe .home-charge-provider{gap:3px;padding:5px 3px}}
@media(max-width:420px){#napthe .home-charge-heading-title{font-size:15px}#napthe .home-charge-heading-sub{font-size:8px}.home-charge-panel .hc-mascot{transform:scale(.8);transform-origin:right top}#napthe .home-charge-heading{padding-right:80px}.home-charge-panel .hc-banner-title{font-size:23px}.home-charge-panel .hc-banner p{font-size:8px;white-space:normal}.home-charge-panel .hc-arrow{display:none}#napthe .home-charge-provider,#napthe .home-charge-more{gap:4px;padding:5px 4px;font-size:9px}#napthe .home-charge-benefits{gap:4px}#napthe .home-charge-benefits span{gap:3px;font-size:9px}}

#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab #pills-chuyen-khoan-tab:before{background-image:url('https://hungakiraroblox.pro/assets/home-charge/bank.svg')!important}
#napthe .home-charge-panel #pills-tab #pills-top-tab:before{background-image:url('https://hungakiraroblox.pro/assets/home-charge/chart.svg')!important}
#napthe .home-charge-more:before{background-image:url('https://hungakiraroblox.pro/assets/home-charge/other-card.svg')!important;background-size:contain!important;background-position:center!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important}

/* V3: chữ banner và logo nhà mạng ở chiều rộng cột PC thực tế */
#napthe .home-charge-panel .hc-banner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr) 27px;gap:9px;align-items:center;min-height:72px;padding:9px 12px;text-decoration:none!important;color:#fff!important}
#napthe .home-charge-panel .hc-banner:hover{filter:brightness(.97);color:#fff!important}
#napthe .home-charge-panel .hc-banner:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffb45e;outline-offset:3px}
#napthe .home-charge-panel .hc-banner-card{width:44px;height:46px}

<style>
/* ==============================================
   CATEGORY STYLE – TÍM NEON (ICON 32PX)
   ============================================== */

.category-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 6px 0;
}

.category-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;

    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1b1026, #221233); /* tím dark */
    color: #e8d9ff;
    padding: 10px 14px;

    border-radius: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 600;

    transition: 0.25s ease;
    box-shadow:
        0 0 10px rgba(130, 70, 255, 0.25),
        0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
}

.category-item:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #2a1740, #3b2260);
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow:
        0 0 15px rgba(170, 90, 255, 0.45),
        0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
}

/* ICON — trả lại kích thước gốc 32px */
.category-icon {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    object-fit: cover;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(150,80,255,0.3);
}

/* TEXT */
.category-text {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    color: #f0e4ff;
}

/* BADGE – Neon Gradient */
.category-badge {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
    margin-left: auto;
    color: #fff;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #b45cff, #ff53d6);
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(200,80,255,0.45);
}

.badge-hot {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff2e72, #ff5bb0);
}

.badge-cheap {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #32d67a, #5bf1a1);
    color: #000;
}

.badge-premium {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7a40ff, #b575ff);
}

.badge-best {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff2ed1, #ff79e6);
}

/* Badge VNG vàng neon */
.badge-vng {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd73a, #ffb300);
    color: #000;
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .category-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 8px;
    }
    .category-item { padding: 8px 12px; }
    .category-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
    .category-text { font-size: 13px; }
}
/* ======================
   MOBILE OPTIMIZED LAYOUT
   ====================== */
@media (max-width: 768px) {

    .category-item {
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        gap: 6px;
    }

    .category-icon {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }

    .category-content {
        padding: 0 4px;
        flex: 1;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .category-text {
        font-size: 13px;
        line-height: 1.2;
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow: hidden;
        word-break: break-word;
    }

    .category-badge {
        font-size: 11px;
        padding: 2px 6px;
    }
}


</style>

                }
            }
            .custom-notification-content-wrapper {
                margin: 0;
                height: 100%;
                color: gray;
                padding-left: 20px;
                padding-right: 20px;
                border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
                flex: 1;
                display: flex !important;
                flex-direction: column;
                justify-content: center;
                .custom-notification-content {
                    font-family: inherit !important;
                    margin: 0 !important;
                    padding: 0 !important;
                    font-size: 14px;
                    line-height: 16px;
                    small {
                        margin-top: 3px !important;
                        display: block !important;
                        font-size: 12px !important;
                        opacity: .8;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .custom-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            right: 8px;
            height: 12px;
            width: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: .2s ease-in-out;
            transform: rotate(45deg);
            opacity: 0;
            &::before {
                content: "";
                display: block;
                width: 100%;
                height: 2px;
                background-color: gray;
                position: absolute;
                left: 0;
                top: 5px;
            }
            &::after {
                content: "";
                display: block;
                height: 100%;
                width: 2px;
                background-color: gray;
                position: absolute;
                left: 5px;
                top: 0;
            }
        }
        &:hover {
            .custom-close {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
    }
}
.scroll-top {
    position: fixed;
    right: 15px;
    bottom: 85px; /* để không che menu mobile */
    width: 55px;
    height: 55px;
    background: #ff3b3b;
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 26px; /* icon to */
    cursor: pointer;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: 0.2s;
    z-index: 9999;
}

/* hiện nút */
.scroll-top.show {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
}

/* mobile tối ưu */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .scroll-top {
        right: 12px;
        bottom: 95px;
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        font-size: 28px;
    }
}

    <script>


function setCookie(cname, cvalue, time) {
  $('#thongbao').modal('hide');
  const d = new Date();
  d.setTime(d.getTime() + (time * 1000));
  let expires = "expires="+d.toUTCString();
  document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
}

function getCookie(cname) {
  let name = cname + "=";
  let ca = document.cookie.split(';');
  for(let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
    let c = ca[i];
    while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
      c = c.substring(1);
    }
    if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
      return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
    }
  }
  return "";
}
/* =====================================
   CHỌN LOẠI THẺ + MỆNH GIÁ TRANG CHỦ
===================================== */

(function () {

    var selectedCard = '';
    var selectedAmount = '';

    function formatMoney(value) {
        return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(Number(value)) + 'đ';
    }


    // Kiểm tra đã nhập đủ thông tin chưa
    function updateSubmitState() {

        var hasCard = selectedCard !== '';
        var hasAmount = selectedAmount !== '';
        var hasPin = $('#mathe').val().trim() !== '';
        var hasSerial = $('#seri').val().trim() !== '';

        $('#homeChargeSubmit').prop(
            'disabled',
            !(hasCard && hasAmount && hasPin && hasSerial)
        );
    }


    function updateChargeBox() {

        // Gán dữ liệu vào hidden input để API cũ vẫn nhận bình thường
        $('#typecard').val(selectedCard);
        $('#chargeAmount').val(selectedAmount);

        if (selectedCard && selectedAmount) {

            var cardText = $('.home-charge-provider.is-selected')
                .text()
                .trim();

            $('#homeChargeTypeText').text(cardText);
            $('#homeChargeAmountText').text(formatMoney(selectedAmount));

            $('#homeChargeSummary').show();

            $('#homeChargeSubmit')
                .text(
                    'NẠP THẺ ' +
                    cardText.toUpperCase() +
                    ' ' +
                    formatMoney(selectedAmount)
                );

        } else {

    $('#homeChargeSummary').hide();

    $('#homeChargeSubmit')
        .prop('disabled', true)
        .text('CHỌN MỆNH GIÁ');
}

        // Sau mỗi lần chọn thẻ/mệnh giá,
        // kiểm tra lại có đủ điều kiện bật nút Nạp chưa
        updateSubmitState();
    }


    /* Chọn nhà mạng + bấm lại để thu gọn */
$('.home-charge-provider').on('click', function () {

    var newCard = $(this).data('value');


    /* =================================
       BẤM LẠI NHÀ MẠNG ĐANG CHỌN
       => THU GỌN FORM
    ================================= */
    if (
        selectedCard === newCard &&
        $('#homeChargeDetails').is(':visible')
    ) {

        // Đóng phần nhập thẻ
        $('#homeChargeDetails')
            .stop(true, true)
            .slideUp(180);


        // Hiện lại box giới thiệu
        setTimeout(function () {

            $('#homeChargeIntro')
                .stop(true, true)
                .slideDown(180);

        }, 160);


        // Cuộn xuống khu danh mục / acc
        setTimeout(function () {

            var target = document.getElementById('shopAccounts');

            if (target) {
                target.scrollIntoView({
                    behavior: 'smooth',
                    block: 'start'
                });
            }

        }, 200);


        return;
    }


    /* =================================
       ĐỔI SANG NHÀ MẠNG KHÁC
       => RESET THÔNG TIN CŨ
    ================================= */
    if (selectedCard !== newCard) {

        selectedAmount = '';

        $('.home-charge-amount')
            .removeClass('is-selected');

        $('#chargeAmount').val('');

        // Xóa thông tin thẻ cũ để tránh gửi nhầm
        $('#mathe').val('');
        $('#seri').val('');

        $('#homeChargeSummary').hide();
    }


    /* =================================
       CHỌN NHÀ MẠNG
    ================================= */
    $('.home-charge-provider')
        .removeClass('is-selected');

    $(this).addClass('is-selected');

    selectedCard = newCard;

    $('#typecard').val(selectedCard);


    /* =================================
       ẨN BOX GIỚI THIỆU
       + MỞ FORM NẠP
    ================================= */
    $('#homeChargeIntro')
        .stop(true, true)
        .slideUp(150);

    $('#homeChargeDetails')
        .stop(true, true)
        .slideDown(220);


    updateChargeBox();

});
    /* Chọn mệnh giá */
    $('.home-charge-amount').on('click', function () {

        $('.home-charge-amount')
            .removeClass('is-selected');

        $(this).addClass('is-selected');

        selectedAmount = $(this).data('value');

        updateChargeBox();
    });


    /* Mở các loại thẻ ít dùng */
    $('#homeChargeMore').on('click', function () {

        $('#homeChargeExtra')
            .toggleClass('is-open');

        if ($('#homeChargeExtra').hasClass('is-open')) {

            $(this).text('THU GỌN ▴');

        } else {

            $(this).text('THẺ KHÁC ▾');
        }
    });


    /* Khi nhập mã thẻ hoặc serial thì kiểm tra lại nút Nạp */
    $('#mathe, #seri').on('input', function () {
        updateSubmitState();
    });


    // Trạng thái ban đầu
    updateChargeBox();

})();


/* =====================================
   POPUP XÁC NHẬN NẠP THẺ
===================================== */

var chargeConfirmed = false;


$('#confirmChargeSubmit').on('click', function () {

    chargeConfirmed = true;

    $('#chargeConfirmModal').modal('hide');

    $('#form-charge2').trigger('submit');

});


$('#form-charge2').submit(function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    var typecard = $('#typecard').val();
    var amount = $('#chargeAmount').val();
    var pin = $('#mathe').val().trim();
    var serial = $('#seri').val().trim();


    if (!typecard || !amount) {

        Notiflix.Notify.failure(
            'Vui lòng chọn loại thẻ và mệnh giá.'
        );

        return false;
    }


    if (!pin || !serial) {

        Notiflix.Notify.failure(
            'Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ mã thẻ và serial.'
        );

        return false;
    }


    var cardName = $('.home-charge-provider.is-selected')
        .text()
        .trim();

    var amountText = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN')
        .format(Number(amount)) + 'đ';


    /* Nếu chưa xác nhận thì mở popup */
if (!chargeConfirmed) {

    $('#confirmCardType')
        .text(cardName.toUpperCase());

    $('#confirmCardAmount')
        .text(amountText);

    $('#confirmChargeSubmit')
        .html(
            '<i class="bx bx-check"></i> ' +
            'Đúng, nạp ' + amountText
        );

    $('#chargeConfirmModal')
        .modal('show');

    return false;
}


/* Đã bấm xác nhận, cho phép gửi API */
chargeConfirmed = false;


    var form = $(this);

                                // ✅ NẠP THÀNH CÔNG
if (data.status == 1 || data.status == '1') {

    if (data.new_balance !== undefined) {

        let formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat()

}

// ❌ NẠP THẤT BẠI
if (data.status == 2 || data.status == '2') {

}
                                });

                            return;

                          var html = '';

                          $('#notification .modal-body').html(html);
                          $('#notification').modal('show');
                    },
                    error: function( jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown ){

<script>

document.addEventListener(
"DOMContentLoaded",
function(){

    /* =========================
       LOGIN
    ========================= */

    const loginForm =
    document.getElementById(
    "handleLogin"
    );

    const errorBox =
    document.getElementById(
    "login-error"
    );

    if(loginForm){

        loginForm.addEventListener(
        "submit",
        async function(e){

            e.preventDefault();

            const username =
            this.querySelector(
            'input[name="username"]'
            );

            const password =
            this.querySelector(
            'input[name="password"]'
            );

            /* VALIDATE */

            if(username.value.trim() === ""){

    username.classList.add("error");

    document.getElementById(
    "loginUsernameError"
    ).style.display = "block";

    document.getElementById(
    "loginUsernameError"
    ).innerText =
    "Tài khoản là bắt buộc.";

    username.focus();

    return;

}else{

    username.classList.remove("error");

    document.getElementById(
    "loginUsernameError"
    ).style.display = "none";
}

            if(password.value.trim() === ""){

    password.classList.add("error");

    document.getElementById(
    "loginPasswordError"
    ).style.display = "block";

    document.getElementById(
    "loginPasswordError"
    ).innerText =
    "Mật khẩu là bắt buộc.";

    password.focus();

    return;

}else{

    password.classList.remove("error");

    document.getElementById(
    "loginPasswordError"
    ).style.display = "none";
}

            /* HIDE ERROR */

            if(errorBox){

                errorBox.style.display =
                "none";
            }

            try{

                const response =
await fetch(

    'https://hungakiraroblox.pro/loginModal',

                    {

                        method:"POST",

                        body:new FormData(
                        loginForm
                        ),

                        headers:{

                            "X-Requested-With":
                            "XMLHttpRequest",

                            "Accept":
                            "application/json"
                        }
                    }
                );

                /* FAIL */

                if(
                    response.status !== 200
                ){

                    if(errorBox){

                        errorBox.style.display =
                        "block";
                    }

                    return;
                }

                /* SUCCESS */

                location.reload();

            }catch(err){

                if(errorBox){

                    errorBox.style.display =
                    "block";
                }
            }

        });
    }

    /* =========================
       TOGGLE PASSWORD
    ========================= */

    window.togglePassword =
    function(){

        const input =
        document.getElementById(
        "loginPassword"
        );

        if(!input) return;

        if(
            input.type === "password"
        ){

            input.type = "text";

        }else{

            input.type = "password";
        }
    }

    /* =========================
       MOBILE SWITCH
    ========================= */

    const showRegister =
    document.getElementById(
    "showRegister"
    );

    const showLogin =
    document.getElementById(
    "showLogin"
    );

    const right =
    document.querySelector(
    ".auth-right"
    );

    const left =
    document.querySelector(
    ".auth-left"
    );

    if(showRegister){

        showRegister.addEventListener(
        "click",
        function(e){

            e.preventDefault();

            left.classList.add("hide");

right.style.display = "flex";

right.classList.add("active");
        });
    }

    if(showLogin){

        showLogin.addEventListener(
        "click",
        function(e){

            e.preventDefault();

            right.classList.remove("active");

right.style.display = "none";

left.classList.remove("hide");
        });
    }

});
/* PASSWORD */

function toggleRegisterPassword(){

    const input =
    document.getElementById(
    "registerPassword"
    );

    if(input.type === "password"){

        input.type = "text";

    }else{

        input.type = "password";
    }
}

/* CONFIRM */

function toggleConfirmPassword(){

    const input =
    document.getElementById(
    "confirmPassword"
    );

    if(input.type === "password"){

        input.type = "text";

    }else{

        input.type = "password";
    }
}
    </script>

    margin-top:18px;

    text-align:center;

    font-size:15px;

    font-weight:700;
}

.op-switch a{

    text-decoration:none;

    font-weight:900;
}

.auth-left .op-switch a{

    color:#e11d48;
}

.auth-right .op-switch a{

    color:#ffd54f;
}

/* MOBILE */

@media(max-width:768px){

    .modal-dialog{

        margin:8px !important;

        max-width:100% !important;
    }

    .auth-container{

        flex-direction:column;
    }

    .auth-left,
    .auth-right{

        width:100%;

        padding:
        90px 20px 36px;
    }

    .auth-title{

        font-size:56px;
    }

    .op-input{

        height:54px;
    }

    .op-btn{

        height:56px;

        font-size:17px;
    }

    .op-center-logo{

        width:70px;

        top:8px;
    }

    .op-decor-left{

        width:90px;
    }
}

/* REGISTER */

.auth-right .auth-title{

    color:#ffffff;
}

/* LOGIN */

.auth-left .auth-title{

    color:#3b1b0d;
}

/* REGISTER */

.auth-right .auth-title{

    color:#fff;
}

.auth-left .auth-title{

    color:#34180d;

    margin-left:-8px;
}

.auth-right .auth-title{

    color:#fff;

    margin-left:-8px;
}

/* SUB */

.auth-sub{

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.4;

    margin-top:2px;

    margin-bottom:22px;

    font-weight:700;
}

/* INPUT GROUP */

.input-group-op{

    position:relative;

    margin-bottom:18px;
}

/* ICON */

.auth-input-icon{

    position:absolute;

    left:18px;

    top:50%;

    transform:translateY(-50%);

    width:24px;

    height:24px;

    object-fit:contain;

    z-index:5;
}

/* EYE */

.eye-icon{

    position:absolute;

    right:18px;

    top:50%;

    transform:translateY(-50%);

    width:24px;

    height:24px;

    object-fit:contain;

    opacity:.7;

    cursor:pointer;

    transition:.3s;
}

.eye-icon:hover{

    opacity:1;
}

/* INPUT */

.op-input{

    width:100%;

    height:58px;

    border-radius:16px;

    border:
    2px solid rgba(255,180,120,.55);

    padding:0 18px;

    margin-bottom:0;

    font-size:16px;

    background:
    rgba(255,255,255,.96);

    outline:none;

    transition:.3s;

    box-shadow:
    inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.05),
    0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}

.op-input:focus{

    border-color:#ffcc33;

    box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px rgba(255,200,50,.15);
}

.has-icon{

    padding-left:58px !important;
}

.has-eye{

    padding-right:55px !important;
}

/* NOTE */

.input-note{

    font-size:13px;

    color:#ffe0a8;

    margin:
    -6px 0 14px 6px;

    font-weight:500;

    line-height:1.3;
}

/* BUTTON */

.op-btn{

    width:100%;

    height:58px;

    border-radius:16px;

    border:none;

    font-size:18px;

    font-weight:900;

    letter-spacing:1px;

    cursor:pointer;

    transition:.25s;

    margin-top:6px;

    text-transform:uppercase;
}

.login-btn-op{

    background:
    linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        #ff4141,
        #d71d1d
    );

    color:#fff;

    border:
    3px solid #b5792d;

    box-shadow:
    0 5px 0 #7d1010;
}

.register-btn-op{

    background:
    linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        #ffd54f,
        #f3b700
    );

    color:#442200;

    border:
    3px solid #b5792d;

    box-shadow:
    0 5px 0 #9a6b00;
}

.op-btn:hover{

    transform:translateY(-2px);
}

/* SWITCH */

.op-switch{

    margin-top:20px;

    text-align:center;

    font-size:15px;

    font-weight:700;

    position:relative;

    z-index:5;

    color:#ffffff;

    text-shadow:
    0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.75);

    background:
    rgba(0,0,0,.18);

    padding:10px 14px;

    border-radius:14px;

    backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
}

.op-switch a{

    text-decoration:none;

    font-weight:900;
}

.auth-left .op-switch a{

    color:#ff4d6d;

    text-shadow:
    0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
}

.auth-right .op-switch a{

    color:#ffe45c;

    text-shadow:
    0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
}

/* MOBILE */

@media(max-width:768px){

    .modal-dialog{

        margin:8px !important;

        max-width:100% !important;
    }

    .modal-content{

        border-radius:20px !important;
    }

    .auth-container{

        flex-direction:column;

        min-height:auto;
    }

    .auth-left,
    .auth-right{

        width:100% !important;

        padding:
        110px 20px 36px;
    }

    .auth-title{

        font-size:42px;

        
    }

    .auth-sub{

        font-size:14px;
    }

    .op-input{

        height:54px;

        font-size:15px;
    }

    .op-btn{

        height:56px;

        font-size:17px;
    }

    .op-center-logo{

        width:70px;

        top:16px;
    }

    .op-decor-left{

        width:95px;
    }

    .modal-title{

        font-size:20px !important;
    }

    .op-switch{

        font-size:14px;
    }
}
.op-switch a{

    position:relative;

    z-index:99999 !important;

    pointer-events:auto !important;

    cursor:pointer !important;
}

.modal-content{

    pointer-events:auto !important;
}

.auth-left,
.auth-right{

    position:relative;

    z-index:2;
}
 .op-close{

    position:absolute;

    top:18px;

    right:18px;

    z-index:999;

    background-size:14px;

    opacity:.7;
}

.op-close:hover{

    opacity:1;
}
.input-error{
    color:#ff4d4f;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    margin-top:6px;
    margin-left:4px;
    display:none;
}

.op-input.error{
    border:2px solid #ff4d4f !important;
    background:#fff8f8;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,77,79,.08);
}
@media(max-width:768px){

    .auth-right{
        display:none;
    }

    .auth-right.active{
        display:flex;
    }

    .auth-left.hide{
        display:none;
    }

}
@media(min-width:769px){

    .op-switch{
        display:none !important;
    }

}

<style>
/* =========================================================
   NẠP THẺ TRANG CHỦ
========================================================= */

#napthe .home-charge-heading,
#napthe #form-charge2 {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
                 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}


/* ================================
   PHẦN CHUNG
================================ */

.home-charge-section {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.home-charge-details {
    display: none;
}


/* ================================
   TIÊU ĐỀ BƯỚC 1 - 2 - 3
================================ */

.home-charge-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;

    color: #202020;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 650;
}

.home-charge-step {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
}


/* ================================
   NHÀ MẠNG
================================ */

.home-charge-provider-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.home-charge-provider,
.home-charge-more {
    min-height: 42px;
    padding: 7px 5px;

    border: 1px solid #dedede;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #252525;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 650;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        border-color .15s ease,
        background-color .15s ease,
        color .15s ease,
        box-shadow .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-provider:hover,
.home-charge-more:hover {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    color: #e53935;
}

.home-charge-provider.is-selected {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    background: #fff5f5;

    color: #e53935;

    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 77, 79, .08);
}


/* ================================
   THẺ ÍT DÙNG
================================ */

.home-charge-extra {
    display: none;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 8px;
}

.home-charge-extra.is-open {
    display: grid;
}


/* ================================
   MỆNH GIÁ
================================ */

.home-charge-amount-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 8px;
}

.home-charge-amount {
    min-height: 42px;

    border: 1px solid #dedede;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #222;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        border-color .15s ease,
        background-color .15s ease,
        color .15s ease,
        box-shadow .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-amount:hover {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    color: #e53935;
}

.home-charge-amount.is-selected {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    background: #ff4d4f;

    color: #fff;

    box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(255, 77, 79, .18);
}


/* ================================
   CẢNH BÁO SAU KHI CHỌN MỆNH GIÁ
================================ */

.home-charge-summary {
    display: none;

    margin-bottom: 14px;
    padding: 10px 12px;

    border: 1px solid #f2cf91;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff9ed;
    color: #77510c;

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.home-charge-summary strong {
    color: #e53935;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.home-charge-summary small {
    display: block;

    margin-top: 4px;

    color: #755b2f;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}


/* ================================
   INPUT
================================ */

.home-charge-input {
    min-height: 42px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    font-family: inherit;
}

.home-charge-input:focus {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 .15rem rgba(255, 77, 79, .10);
}


/* ================================
   NÚT NẠP
================================ */

.home-charge-submit {
    min-height: 46px;

    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;

    transition:
        background-color .15s ease,
        opacity .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-submit:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: #e93d40;
    color: #fff;
}

.home-charge-submit:disabled {
    background: #e6e6e6;
    color: #999;

    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 1;
}


/* =========================================================
   HEADER "NẠP THẺ NHANH"
========================================================= */

.home-charge-heading {
    padding: 1px 0 5px;
}

.home-charge-heading-icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    margin-right: 9px;

    border-radius: 9px;

    background: #fff1f1;
    color: #f04444;

    font-size: 23px;
}

.home-charge-heading-title {
    color: #161616;

    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: -.15px;
}

.home-charge-heading-sub {
    margin-top: 2px;

    color: #777;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
}


/* =========================================================
   BOX "NẠP THẺ TỰ ĐỘNG 24/7"
========================================================= */

.home-charge-intro {
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 12px 13px;

    border: 1px solid #f0d3ad;
    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #fffaf3;
}

.home-charge-intro-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.home-charge-intro-icon {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    margin-right: 10px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-size: 22px;
}

.home-charge-intro-title {
    color: #df3438;

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.25;
    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: 0;
}

.home-charge-intro-text {
    margin-top: 3px;

    color: #666;

    font-size: 11.5px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
}


/* 3 ƯU ĐIỂM */

.home-charge-benefits {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 11px;
}

.home-charge-benefits span {
    padding: 7px 3px;

    border: 1px solid #f3eee8;
    border-radius: 7px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #444;

    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.25;
    font-weight: 600;

    text-align: center;
}


/* CẢNH BÁO DƯỚI BOX */

.home-charge-intro-warning {
    margin-top: 9px;
    padding-top: 8px;

    border-top: 1px dashed #e8c181;

    color: #825708;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 500;
}


/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 767px) {

    /* Nhà mạng: 2 nút / hàng */
    .home-charge-provider-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .home-charge-provider,
    .home-charge-more {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 13px;
    }


    /* Mệnh giá: 3 nút / hàng */
    .home-charge-amount {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 15px;
    }


    /* Input */
    .home-charge-input {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 16px;
    }


    /* Nút nạp */
    .home-charge-submit {
        min-height: 50px;
        font-size: 15px;
    }


    /* Tiêu đề */
    .home-charge-heading-title {
        font-size: 17px;
    }

    .home-charge-heading-sub {
        font-size: 11px;
    }


    /* Box giới thiệu */
    .home-charge-intro {
        margin-top: 11px;
        padding: 11px 12px;
    }

    .home-charge-intro-title {
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    .home-charge-intro-text {
        font-size: 11.5px;
    }


    /* Vẫn giữ 3 ô trên mobile để box không quá dài */
    .home-charge-benefits {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 5px;
    }

    .home-charge-benefits span {
        padding: 6px 3px;
        font-size: 9.5px;
    }


    .home-charge-summary {
        font-size: 13px;
    }
}
/* =========================================================
   POPUP XÁC NHẬN NẠP THẺ
========================================================= */

.charge-confirm-modal {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);

}

.charge-confirm-icon {

.charge-confirm-modal .modal-title {

}

.charge-confirm-info {
    margin-top: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #eee;
    border-radius: 11px;

    background: #fafafa;

.charge-confirm-row {

}

.charge-confirm-row span {
    color: #666;
}

.charge-confirm-row strong {
    color: #e53935;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.charge-confirm-warning {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 1px solid #f1d39d;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #fff9ec;
    color: #79520d;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.45;
}

.charge-confirm-warning-icon {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: #e29a15;
    font-size: 21px;
}

.charge-confirm-warning strong {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    color: #654300;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.charge-confirm-back,
.charge-confirm-submit {
    min-height: 46px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.charge-confirm-back {
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    background: #fff;
    color: #555;
}

.charge-confirm-back:hover {
    background: #f5f5f5;
    color: #333;
}

.charge-confirm-submit {
    border: 0;
    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;
}

.charge-confirm-submit:hover {
    background: #e93d40;
    color: #fff;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {

    #chargeConfirmModal .modal-dialog {
        margin: 15px;
    }

    .charge-confirm-modal .modal-title {
        font-size: 19px;
    }

    .charge-confirm-row {
        padding: 12px;
    }

    .charge-confirm-back,
    .charge-confirm-submit {
        min-height: 48px;
    }
}

<style>
/* ==============================================
   CATEGORY STYLE – TÍM NEON (ICON 32PX)
   ============================================== */

.category-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 6px 0;
}

.category-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;

    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1b1026, #221233); /* tím dark */
    color: #e8d9ff;
    padding: 10px 14px;

    border-radius: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 600;

    transition: 0.25s ease;
    box-shadow:
        0 0 10px rgba(130, 70, 255, 0.25),
        0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
}

.category-item:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #2a1740, #3b2260);
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow:
        0 0 15px rgba(170, 90, 255, 0.45),
        0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
}

/* ICON — trả lại kích thước gốc 32px */
.category-icon {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    object-fit: cover;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(150,80,255,0.3);
}

/* TEXT */
.category-text {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    color: #f0e4ff;
}

/* BADGE – Neon Gradient */
.category-badge {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
    margin-left: auto;
    color: #fff;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #b45cff, #ff53d6);
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(200,80,255,0.45);
}

.badge-hot {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff2e72, #ff5bb0);
}

.badge-cheap {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #32d67a, #5bf1a1);
    color: #000;
}

.badge-premium {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7a40ff, #b575ff);
}

.badge-best {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff2ed1, #ff79e6);
}

/* Badge VNG vàng neon */
.badge-vng {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd73a, #ffb300);
    color: #000;
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .category-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 8px;
    }
    .category-item { padding: 8px 12px; }
    .category-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
    .category-text { font-size: 13px; }
}
/* ======================
   MOBILE OPTIMIZED LAYOUT
   ====================== */
@media (max-width: 768px) {

    .category-item {
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        gap: 6px;
    }

    .category-icon {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }

    .category-content {
        padding: 0 4px;
        flex: 1;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .category-text {
        font-size: 13px;
        line-height: 1.2;
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow: hidden;
        word-break: break-word;
    }

    .category-badge {
        font-size: 11px;
        padding: 2px 6px;
    }
}


</style>

.custom-social-proof {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 65px;

    z-index: 9999999999999 !important;
  font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
    display: none;  /* Uncoment This Line to Hide Initially*/
    .custom-notification {
        width: 320px;
        border: 0;
        text-align: left;
        z-index: 99999;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        font-weight: 400;
        border-radius: 6px;
        box-shadow: 2px 2px 10px 2px hsla(0, 4%, 4%, 0.2);
        background-color: #fff;
        position: relative;
        cursor: pointer;
        .custom-notification-container {
            display: flex !important;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100px;
            .custom-notification-image-wrapper {
                img {
                    max-height: 95px;
                    width: 90px;
                    overflow: hidden;
                    border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px;
                    object-fit: cover;
                }
            }
            .custom-notification-content-wrapper {
                margin: 0;
                height: 100%;
                color: gray;
                padding-left: 20px;
                padding-right: 20px;
                border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
                flex: 1;
                display: flex !important;
                flex-direction: column;
                justify-content: center;
                .custom-notification-content {
                    font-family: inherit !important;
                    margin: 0 !important;
                    padding: 0 !important;
                    font-size: 14px;
                    line-height: 16px;
                    small {
                        margin-top: 3px !important;
                        display: block !important;
                        font-size: 12px !important;
                        opacity: .8;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .custom-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            right: 8px;
            height: 12px;
            width: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: .2s ease-in-out;
            transform: rotate(45deg);
            opacity: 0;
            &::before {
                content: "";
                display: block;
                width: 100%;
                height: 2px;
                background-color: gray;
                position: absolute;
                left: 0;
                top: 5px;
            }
            &::after {
                content: "";
                display: block;
                height: 100%;
                width: 2px;
                background-color: gray;
                position: absolute;
                left: 5px;
                top: 0;
            }
        }
        &:hover {
            .custom-close {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
    }
}

function setCookie(cname, cvalue, time) {
  $('#thongbao').modal('hide');
  const d = new Date();
  d.setTime(d.getTime() + (time * 1000));
  let expires = "expires="+d.toUTCString();
  document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
}

function getCookie(cname) {
  let name = cname + "=";
  let ca = document.cookie.split(';');
  for(let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
    let c = ca[i];
    while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
      c = c.substring(1);
    }
    if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
      return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
    }
  }
  return "";
}

===================================== */

(function () {

    var selectedAmount = '';

    }

    function updateSubmitState() {

        var hasCard = selectedCard !== '';
        var hasAmount = selectedAmount !== '';
        var hasPin = $('#mathe').val().trim() !== '';
        var hasSerial = $('#seri').val().trim() !== '';

        $('#homeChargeSubmit').prop(
            'disabled',
            !(hasCard && hasAmount && hasPin && hasSerial)
        );
    }

        // Gán dữ liệu vào hidden input để API cũ vẫn nhận bình thường
        $('#typecard').val(selectedCard);

        if (selectedCard && selectedAmount) {

            var cardText = $('.home-charge-provider.is-selected')
                .text()

            $('#homeChargeTypeText').text(cardText);
            $('#homeChargeAmountText').text(formatMoney(selectedAmount));

            $('#homeChargeSummary').show();

            $('#homeChargeSubmit')
                .text(
                    'NẠP THẺ ' +
                    cardText.toUpperCase() +
                    ' ' +

                );

        } else {

    $('#homeChargeSummary').hide();

    $('#homeChargeSubmit')
        .prop('disabled', true)

}

        // Sau mỗi lần chọn thẻ/mệnh giá,
        // kiểm tra lại có đủ điều kiện bật nút Nạp chưa
        updateSubmitState();
    }


    /* Chọn nhà mạng + bấm lại để thu gọn */
$('.home-charge-provider').on('click', function () {

    var newCard = $(this).data('value');


    /* =================================
       BẤM LẠI NHÀ MẠNG ĐANG CHỌN
       => THU GỌN FORM
    ================================= */
    if (
        selectedCard === newCard &&

    ) {

        // Đóng phần nhập thẻ

            .stop(true, true)

        // Hiện lại box giới thiệu
        setTimeout(function () {

        }, 160);


        // Cuộn xuống khu danh mục / acc

            var target = document.getElementById('shopAccounts');

            if (target) {
                target.scrollIntoView({
                    behavior: 'smooth',
                    block: 'start'
                });
            }

        }, 200);


        return;
    }


    /* =================================
       ĐỔI SANG NHÀ MẠNG KHÁC
       => RESET THÔNG TIN CŨ
    ================================= */
    if (selectedCard !== newCard) {

        selectedAmount = '';

        $('.home-charge-amount')
            .removeClass('is-selected');

        $('#chargeAmount').val('');

        // Xóa thông tin thẻ cũ để tránh gửi nhầm
        $('#mathe').val('');
        $('#seri').val('');

        $('#homeChargeSummary').hide();
    }


    /* =================================
       CHỌN NHÀ MẠNG
    ================================= */
    $('.home-charge-provider')
        .removeClass('is-selected');

    $(this).addClass('is-selected');

    selectedCard = newCard;

    $('#typecard').val(selectedCard);


    /* =================================
       ẨN BOX GIỚI THIỆU

    $('#homeChargeIntro')
        .stop(true, true)
        .slideUp(150);

    $('#homeChargeDetails')
        .stop(true, true)
        .slideDown(220);


    updateChargeBox();

});
    /* Chọn mệnh giá */
    $('.home-charge-amount').on('click', function () {

        $('.home-charge-amount')
            .removeClass('is-selected');

        $(this).addClass('is-selected');

        selectedAmount = $(this).data('value');

        updateChargeBox();
    });


    /* Mở các loại thẻ ít dùng */
    $('#homeChargeMore').on('click', function () {

        $('#homeChargeExtra')
            .toggleClass('is-open');

        if ($('#homeChargeExtra').hasClass('is-open')) {

            $(this).text('THU GỌN ▴');

        } else {

            $(this).text('THẺ KHÁC ▾');
        }
    });


    /* Khi nhập mã thẻ hoặc serial thì kiểm tra lại nút Nạp */
    $('#mathe, #seri').on('input', function () {
        updateSubmitState();
    });


    // Trạng thái ban đầu
    updateChargeBox();

})();

}

    password.classList.add("error");

    document.getElementById(
    "loginPasswordError"
    ).style.display = "block";

    document.getElementById(
    "loginPasswordError"
    ).innerText =
    "Mật khẩu là bắt buộc.";

    password.focus();

    return;

}else{

    password.classList.remove("error");

    document.getElementById(
    "loginPasswordError"
    ).style.display = "none";
}

            /* HIDE ERROR */

            if(errorBox){

                errorBox.style.display =
                "none";
            }

            try{

                const response =
await fetch(

    'https://hungakiraroblox.pro/loginModal',

                    {

                        method:"POST",

                        body:new FormData(
                        loginForm
                        ),

                        headers:{

                            "X-Requested-With":
                            "XMLHttpRequest",

                            "Accept":
                            "application/json"
                        }
                    }
                );

                /* FAIL */

                if(
                    response.status !== 200
                ){

                    if(errorBox){

                        errorBox.style.display =
                        "block";
                    }

                    return;
                }

                /* SUCCESS */

                location.reload();

            }catch(err){

                if(errorBox){

                    errorBox.style.display =
                    "block";
                }
            }

        });
    }

    /* =========================
       TOGGLE PASSWORD
    ========================= */

    window.togglePassword =
    function(){

        const input =
        document.getElementById(
        "loginPassword"
        );

        if(!input) return;

        if(
            input.type === "password"
        ){

            input.type = "text";

        }else{

            input.type = "password";
        }
    }

    /* =========================
       MOBILE SWITCH
    ========================= */

    const showRegister =
    document.getElementById(
    "showRegister"
    );

    const showLogin =
    document.getElementById(
    "showLogin"
    );

    const right =
    document.querySelector(
    ".auth-right"
    );

    const left =
    document.querySelector(
    ".auth-left"
    );

    if(showRegister){

        showRegister.addEventListener(
        "click",
        function(e){

            e.preventDefault();

            left.classList.add("hide");

right.style.display = "flex";

right.classList.add("active");
        });
    }

    if(showLogin){

        showLogin.addEventListener(
        "click",
        function(e){

            e.preventDefault();

            right.classList.remove("active");

right.style.display = "none";

left.classList.remove("hide");
        });
    }

});
/* PASSWORD */

function toggleRegisterPassword(){

    const input =
    document.getElementById(
    "registerPassword"
    );

    if(input.type === "password"){

        input.type = "text";

    }else{

        input.type = "password";
    }
}

/* CONFIRM */

function toggleConfirmPassword(){

    const input =
    document.getElementById(
    "confirmPassword"
    );

    if(input.type === "password"){

        input.type = "text";

    }else{

        input.type = "password";
    }
}

/* =========================================================
   NẠP THẺ TRANG CHỦ
========================================================= */

#napthe .home-charge-heading,
#napthe #form-charge2 {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
                 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}


/* ================================
   PHẦN CHUNG
================================ */

.home-charge-section {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.home-charge-details {
    display: none;
}


/* ================================
   TIÊU ĐỀ BƯỚC 1 - 2 - 3
================================ */

.home-charge-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;

    color: #202020;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 650;
}

.home-charge-step {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
}


/* ================================
   NHÀ MẠNG
================================ */

.home-charge-provider-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.home-charge-provider,
.home-charge-more {
    min-height: 42px;
    padding: 7px 5px;

    border: 1px solid #dedede;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #252525;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 650;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        border-color .15s ease,
        background-color .15s ease,
        color .15s ease,
        box-shadow .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-provider:hover,
.home-charge-more:hover {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    color: #e53935;
}

.home-charge-provider.is-selected {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    background: #fff5f5;

    color: #e53935;

    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 77, 79, .08);
}


/* ================================
   THẺ ÍT DÙNG
================================ */

.home-charge-extra {
    display: none;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 8px;
}

.home-charge-extra.is-open {
    display: grid;
}


/* ================================
   MỆNH GIÁ
================================ */

.home-charge-amount-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 8px;
}

.home-charge-amount {
    min-height: 42px;

    border: 1px solid #dedede;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #222;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        border-color .15s ease,
        background-color .15s ease,
        color .15s ease,
        box-shadow .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-amount:hover {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    color: #e53935;
}

.home-charge-amount.is-selected {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;
    background: #ff4d4f;

    color: #fff;

    box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(255, 77, 79, .18);
}


/* ================================
   CẢNH BÁO SAU KHI CHỌN MỆNH GIÁ
================================ */

.home-charge-summary {
    display: none;

    margin-bottom: 14px;
    padding: 10px 12px;

    border: 1px solid #f2cf91;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #fff9ed;
    color: #77510c;

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.home-charge-summary strong {
    color: #e53935;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.home-charge-summary small {
    display: block;

    margin-top: 4px;

    color: #755b2f;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}


/* ================================
   INPUT
================================ */

.home-charge-input {
    min-height: 42px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    font-family: inherit;
}

.home-charge-input:focus {
    border-color: #ff4d4f;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 .15rem rgba(255, 77, 79, .10);
}


/* ================================
   NÚT NẠP
================================ */

.home-charge-submit {
    min-height: 46px;

    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;

    transition:
        background-color .15s ease,
        opacity .15s ease;
}

.home-charge-submit:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: #e93d40;
    color: #fff;
}

.home-charge-submit:disabled {
    background: #e6e6e6;
    color: #999;

    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 1;
}


/* =========================================================
   HEADER "NẠP THẺ NHANH"
========================================================= */

.home-charge-heading {
    padding: 1px 0 5px;
}

.home-charge-heading-icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    margin-right: 9px;

    border-radius: 9px;

    background: #fff1f1;
    color: #f04444;

    font-size: 23px;
}

.home-charge-heading-title {
    color: #161616;

    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: -.15px;
}

.home-charge-heading-sub {
    margin-top: 2px;

    color: #777;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
}


/* =========================================================
   BOX "NẠP THẺ TỰ ĐỘNG 24/7"
========================================================= */

.home-charge-intro {
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 12px 13px;

    border: 1px solid #f0d3ad;
    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #fffaf3;
}

.home-charge-intro-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.home-charge-intro-icon {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;

    margin-right: 10px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #ff4d4f;
    color: #fff;

    font-size: 22px;
}

.home-charge-intro-title {
    color: #df3438;

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.25;
    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: 0;
}

.home-charge-intro-text {
    margin-top: 3px;

    color: #666;

    font-size: 11.5px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
}


/* 3 ƯU ĐIỂM */

.home-charge-benefits {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 11px;
}

.home-charge-benefits span {
    padding: 7px 3px;

    border: 1px solid #f3eee8;
    border-radius: 7px;

    background: #fff;
    color: #444;

    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.25;
    font-weight: 600;

    text-align: center;
}


/* CẢNH BÁO DƯỚI BOX */

.home-charge-intro-warning {
    margin-top: 9px;
    padding-top: 8px;

    border-top: 1px dashed #e8c181;

    color: #825708;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 500;
}


/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 767px) {

    /* Nhà mạng: 2 nút / hàng */
    .home-charge-provider-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .home-charge-provider,
    .home-charge-more {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 13px;
    }


    /* Mệnh giá: 3 nút / hàng */
    .home-charge-amount {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 15px;
    }


    /* Input */
    .home-charge-input {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 16px;
    }


    /* Nút nạp */
    .home-charge-submit {
        min-height: 50px;
        font-size: 15px;
    }


    /* Tiêu đề */
    .home-charge-heading-title {
        font-size: 17px;
    }

    .home-charge-heading-sub {
        font-size: 11px;
    }


    /* Box giới thiệu */
    .home-charge-intro {
        margin-top: 11px;
        padding: 11px 12px;
    }

    .home-charge-intro-title {
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    .home-charge-intro-text {
        font-size: 11.5px;
    }


    /* Vẫn giữ 3 ô trên mobile để box không quá dài */
    .home-charge-benefits {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 5px;
    }

    .home-charge-benefits span {
        padding: 6px 3px;
        font-size: 9.5px;
    }


    .home-charge-summary {
        font-size: 13px;
    }
}
/* =========================================================
   POPUP XÁC NHẬN NẠP THẺ
========================================================= */

.charge-confirm-modal {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
                 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}

.charge-confirm-modal .modal-header {

}

.charge-confirm-icon {

}

.charge-confirm-modal .modal-title {
    color: #181818;
    font-size: 20px;

    font-weight: 700;
}

.charge-confirm-sub {
    margin-top: 4px;
    color: #888;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.charge-confirm-info {
    margin-top: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #eee;
    border-radius: 11px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #fafafa;
}

.charge-confirm-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.charge-confirm-row + .charge-confirm-row {
    border-top: 1px solid #eee;
}

.charge-confirm-row span {
    color: #666;
}

.charge-confirm-row strong {
    color: #e53935;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.charge-confirm-warning {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 1px solid #f1d39d;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #fff9ec;
    color: #79520d;
    font-size: 12px;

}

.charge-confirm-warning-icon {
    flex-shrink: 0;

}

.charge-confirm-warning strong {

}

.charge-confirm-back,
.charge-confirm-submit {
    min-height: 46px;

}

.charge-confirm-back {

}

.charge-confirm-back:hover {

}

.charge-confirm-submit {

}

    color: #fff;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {

    #chargeConfirmModal .modal-dialog {
        margin: 15px;
    }

    }

    .charge-confirm-row {

    }

#napthe .home-charge-panel .hc-logo{width:35px;height:24px;flex:none}
